description: This file implements the OCDM (Open Content Decryption Module) JSON-RPC interface for the WPEFramework plugin, providing methods to retrieve supported DRM systems and key systems, and managing registration of these properties.

classes.name: OCDM
classes.description: Class implementing the OCDM JSON-RPC interface, managing supported DRM systems and key systems.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers the 'drms' and 'keysystems' properties for the OCDM plugin.

methods.name: KeySystems
methods.description: Retrieves the list of key systems for a given DRM name.

methods.name: get_drms
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported DRM systems.

methods.name: get_keysystems
methods.description: Retrieves the key systems for a specified DRM.
